summary: Security update for the Linux Kernel (Live Patch 9 for SUSE Linux Enterprise 16)
details:
This update for the SUSE Linux Enterprise Kernel 6.12.0-160000.30.1 fixes various security issues:

The following security issues were fixed:

- CVE-2026-53016: crypto: ccp - copy IV using skcipher ivsize (bsc#1269766).
- CVE-2026-53381: virtiofs: fix UAF on submount umount (bsc#1271837).
- CVE-2026-63968: ipv6: fix possible infinite loop in fib6_select_path() (bsc#1272521).
- CVE-2026-64053: block: don't overwrite bip_vcnt in bio_integrity_copy_user() (bsc#1272986).
- CVE-2026-64217: netfs: Fix overrun check in netfs_extract_user_iter() (bsc#1272874).
- CVE-2026-68426: xfrm: fix stale skb->prev after async crypto steals a GSO segment (bsc#1274712).
- CVE-2026-72262: ASoC: SOF: ipc3-control: Fix heap overflow in bytes_ext put/get (bsc#1277679).
- CVE-2026-74469: sctp: prevent peer transport count overflow (bsc#1280693).
- CVE-2026-74669: ipvs: clear IPv4 options after rebasing tunnel ICMP errors (bsc#1277399).
- CVE-2026-80521: af_unix: Unlink scc_entry in unix_del_edge() (bsc#1282495).
- CVE-2026-80530,CVE-2026-97547: xfs: fix exchange-range reflink flag clearing issue with INO1_WRITTEN (XFSTango)"
  (bsc#1278410 bsc#1283484).
- CVE-2026-89544: SUNRPC: fix gssx_dec_option_array error path bugs (bsc#1280760).
- CVE-2026-89551: SUNRPC: xdr_buf_trim: clamp buf->len to avoid underflow (bsc#1280728).
- CVE-2026-89674: nfsd: fix XDR length calculation in nfsd4_ff_encode_layoutget (bsc#1280285).
- CVE-2026-98432: ipv4: free inet_opt and ireq_opt after an RCU grace period (bsc#1285686).
